name: cli-e2e
description: Write, modify, or debug Docker-based Composio CLI end-to-end tests under ts/e2e-tests/cli, including binary invocation, fixture isolation, output assertions, and package manifests. Use for CLI E2E test suites only; use cli-command for CLI source implementation.
author: ComposioHQ
summary_zh: 面向 Composio CLI 的 Docker 端到端测试工具，适合验证命令执行、环境隔离与输出结果。
